limitations: Counts are declaration occurrences, not unique product operations or coverage percentages.
MCP literal candidates may include test declarations; actual tools/list must verify them.
Generated tools, dynamic aliases, conditional routes, shell CLIs and direct UI/agent mutations require owner review.
Only literal renderer calls are enumerated; wrapper and computed calls require owner review.
No handler execution, authentication, side effect, installed-client compatibility or parity has been verified.
Source hashes identify inspected working files; baseCommit alone does not assert a clean checkout.
